summary: Defines the NAS-Filter-Rule attribute for RADIUS. RFC 2865 only lets a server name a filter that the network access server already has configured. This attribute lets the server send the actual filter rules directly, which helps when the operator does not know what the access server has preinstalled. It is on the standards track.

eli5.summary: A door guard usually has a list of rules written down already. This lets the boss hand the guard new rules on the spot, so the boss does not have to guess what the guard already knows.

questions: what is the radius nas-filter-rule attribute
how to send filter rules in radius
